comments.typescript: typescript@5.9.3 rather than the 7 line: openapi-typescript@7.13.0 generates src/api/generated.ts with the TypeScript 5 compiler API (ts.factory), which the native typescript@7 port does not expose, and npm cannot nest a peer dependency to give the generator its own copy. Every other dev tool here (shadcn, msw, vitest) already peers against a 4.x/5.x range. Recorded in the ARCHITECTURE Decision log, 2026-07-21.
comments.overrides: @redocly/openapi-core pins js-yaml 4.2.0 exactly, which carries GHSA-52cp-r559-cp3m, so npm audit fix cannot resolve it in range. The override lifts that transitive copy to the patched 4.3.0 within the same major. It reaches only the build-time OpenAPI generator; no js-yaml ships to the browser.
